name: @adobe-commerce/commerce-extensibility-tools

tools.name: aio-app-deploy
tools.description: Deploy an Adobe I/O App to runtime. Can deploy specific actions or the entire app.

action.description: Specific action name to deploy (optional). Format: packageName/actionName. If not provided, deploys the entire app. This will automatically set --no-publish flag.

skipBuild.description: Skip the build phase using --no-build (optional, default: false)

skipStatic.description: Skip deployment of web assets using --no-web-assets (optional, default: false)

skipActions.description: Skip deployment of actions using --no-actions (optional, default: false)

forceBuild.description: Force build even if no changes detected using --force-build (optional, default: false)

forceDeploy.description: Force deploy even if no changes detected using --force-deploy (optional, default: false)

tools.name: aio-app-dev
tools.description: Start a local development server for Adobe I/O App. Runs the app locally for development and testing.

extension.description: Run only a specific extension (optional). This flag can only be specified once.

open.description: Open the default web browser after a successful run (optional, only valid if your app has a front-end)

tools.name: aio-app-use
tools.description: Configure the runtime namespace for the current Adobe I/O App project.

tools.name: aio-configure-global
tools.description: Change the global Adobe I/O configuration (org, project, workspace). Can list available options or set specific values.

org.description: Organization name to select (required for select-org)

project.description: Project name to select (required for select-project)

workspace.description: Workspace name to select (required for select-workspace)

tools.name: aio-dev-invoke
tools.description: Invoke a runtime action that is running locally via aio app dev. Can discover available actions and call them with parameters.

actionName.description: Name of the action to invoke (e.g., "starter-kit/info"). Required unless discoverActions is true.

parameters.description: JSON object of parameters to pass to the action (optional)

method.description: HTTP method to use (GET, POST, PUT, etc.). Default: POST

port.description: Port number where the dev server is running (optional, default: 9080)

discoverActions.description: Discover available actions by testing common action names (optional, default: false)

tools.name: aio-login
tools.description: Log in to Adobe I/O. Opens browser for OAuth2 authentication and handles the login flow.

force.description: Force logging in (logout first and ignore cached data)

context.description: Name of the Adobe IMS context to use (optional)

openBrowser.description: Open the default browser to complete login

tools.name: aio-where
tools.description: Show current Adobe I/O configuration (org, project, workspace) and ask for deployment confirmation.

tools.name: commerce-event-subscribe
tools.description: Run npm run commerce-event-subscribe to subscribe to Commerce events for product and customer changes. This script sets up event listeners for catalog operations, customer operations, and customer group operations using Commerce OAuth1 authentication.

tools.name: onboard
tools.description: Run npm run onboard to configure Adobe I/O event providers and the Adobe I/O Events for Commerce module. This script creates event providers, registers event metadata, creates event registrations, and configures the Commerce Events module. It handles authentication, provider creation, and Commerce integration setup.

tools.name: search-commerce-docs
tools.description: Search Adobe Commerce and App Builder documentation for coding guidance and implementation details. The backend intelligently finds the most relevant documentation based on your query.

query.description: Your search query (e.g., 'How do I create an order via REST API?', 'webhook configuration', 'storefront drop-ins')

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (optional, defaults to 5)

tools.name: upload-chat-history
tools.description: Collects chat history messages and uploads them to a configurable server endpoint

messages.description: Array of chat messages to upload

role.description: The role of the message sender

feedback.description: Optional user feedback about the chat session

saveLocally.description: Set to 'yes' (case insensitive) to save the chat history to a local file in the chats folder. Any other value or empty will not save locally.
